classification_semantics.automated_full: The current dependency-free validator independently executes every assertion in the gate.
classification_semantics.automated_partial: The validator executes at least one core assertion, but one or more semantic assertions remain uncovered or trust an upstream value.
classification_semantics.manual_release: The current validator does not execute the gate's substantive semantic checks; an independent manual or release-time process is required.

result_interpretation: A validator pass means that the schema shape and the implemented automated assertions passed for the supplied records. It never means that all 29 QA gates passed, that release-time gates passed, or that an empirical dataset exists.
